title: Replace the wall-clock lock with a task-boundary self-report and collapse to one ledger

outcomes.statement: No git-timestamp checkpoint can force a stop disconnected from task structure, and the artifact no longer carries a checkpoints[] array that must byte-match the feedback log.
outcomes.demo: A work item whose commits span more than 90 minutes of git time passes check-staged; the artifact schema no longer accepts checkpoints[], and no WR_CHECKPOINT_* or WR_EXECUTION_ANCHOR_* code is reachable.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the clock removal and the dual-ledger collapse can be separate children.
uncertainties.resolution: They cannot be separated safely — the artifact side mirrors the clock, so landing the clock removal alone leaves three checkpoint validators dead-but-passing. Declared as one child.

uncertainties.statement: Whether WR_FEEDBACK_HISTORY_MUTATED is bijection machinery, as the parent design states.
uncertainties.resolution: It is not. validateFeedbackHistoryTransition (git.mjs:306) is a pure byte-prefix append-only guard on .nous-feedback.jsonl and never reads the artifact side. It stays; removing it would leave the surviving single ledger silently rewritable.
